## Services

### Blocked Drains
CCTV drain camera inspection and jet blasting. Same-day service for blocked drains across Melbourne. We locate the blockage, show you the footage, and clear it on the spot.
- URL: https://koveleplumbing.com.au/blocked-drains

### Gas & Hot Water Systems
Licensed gas fitters. Installation, repair, and servicing of all hot water system types: electric, gas, solar, and heat pump. All major brands.
- URL: https://koveleplumbing.com.au/gas-hot-water

### Roof Plumbing
Roof leak detection, gutter repairs, downpipe replacement, and roof flashing repairs. We find the source of the leak and fix it properly.
- URL: https://koveleplumbing.com.au/roof-plumbing

### General Plumbing
Tap repairs, pipe relining, leak detection, water pressure issues, and all general plumbing maintenance for Melbourne homes.
- URL: https://koveleplumbing.com.au/general-plumbing

### Toilet Repairs
Cistern repairs, blockage clearing, new toilet installations, and smart toilet fitting. Same-day service available.
- URL: https://koveleplumbing.com.au/toilet-repairs

### Bathroom Renovations
Full plumbing for bathroom renovations. Rough-in, fit-off, waterproofing coordination. 150+ bathroom renovations completed across Melbourne.
- URL: https://koveleplumbing.com.au/bathroom-renovations

### Emergency Plumbing
24/7 emergency plumber. Average response time 60 minutes across Melbourne. Burst pipes, flooding, gas leaks, blocked drains.
- URL: https://koveleplumbing.com.au/emergency-plumber

## FAQ

### How quickly can you respond to emergencies?
Average emergency response time is 60 minutes across Melbourne. Steve answers the phone 24/7.

### Do you charge for travel time?
No. Our quotes include everything: travel, labour, and parts. The price we quote is the price you pay.

### Are you licensed and insured?
Fully licensed with the Victorian Building Authority (VBA) and insured. Both Steve and Nick are licensed plumbers and gas fitters.

### Do you offer free quotes?
Yes. For most jobs, Steve can give a cost estimate over the phone. For larger jobs, we visit your home for a free, no-obligation quote.
